name: mail-access-expires-today
description: A partner's account access to the feed ends tonight unless it is renewed: only the user can renew it and the deadline is today, so the user is told now.

item.subject: Your feed access expires tonight
item.text: Hello, your account access to our results feed ends tonight at 23:59 UTC unless it is renewed. Renewal needs a signed form from an authorized person at your company. Reply today if you want to keep the access. Thanks, Results Partner IT
